scenarios.name: customer identity and client-supplied customer_id
observed: Native and legacy carts created with a customer token use the authenticated customer identity.
Both APIs reject customer_id supplied by the client.
scenarios.test: associates only the verified customer identity; rejects identity, price or channel tampering

scenarios.name: staff actor separation and guest carts
observed: Staff token authenticates at /admin/users/me and is rejected at /store/customers/me.
Native and legacy carts created with that staff token remain guest carts without customer_id.
scenarios.test: accepts a staff invite and keeps customer authentication separate

scenarios.name: invalid and expired customer tokens
observed: Protected customer profile requests reject missing, invalid, and expired tokens with 401.
Guest carts created with invalid or expired customer tokens have no customer_id.
tests: protects the customer profile and keeps invalid-token carts anonymous
does not associate carts with expired customer tokens

scenarios.name: legacy cart response projection
observed: Cart response contains only id, region_id, currency_code, and items.
Each item contains only id, variant_id, and quantity; supplied contact email is not returned.
scenarios.test: preserves guest creation and projects public fields

scenarios.name: quantity validation
scenarios.observed: Both native and legacy line-item endpoints reject every listed value with HTTP 400.
scenarios.test: rejects invalid quantity %j before invoking commerce

scenarios.name: cross-cart line-item deletion
observed: Deleting a line item through either API while naming another cart returns 404.
The original cart retains its line item.
Deleting from the matching cart succeeds through both APIs.
scenarios.test: does not delete a line belonging to a different cart

scenarios.name: published product and sales-channel constraints
observed: Native and legacy catalogs do not expose the draft product.
An isolated publishable-key channel sees no products linked to another channel.
Both cart APIs reject a channel outside the publishable key and a variant from another channel.
Both cart APIs reject adding an unpublished product.
tests: scopes native and legacy catalog and carts to the publishable key channel
does not include unpublished products in the catalog

privacy: No customer credentials, bearer tokens, publishable-key values, or production records are included.
